title: Database size rank within each server
description: For each database compute size_rank within its server_name using DENSE_RANK by size_gb DESC. Databases with the same size share a rank with no gaps. Return exactly four columns: server_name, database_name, size_gb, size_rank. Final sort: server_name ASC, size_rank ASC, database_name ASC.
starter_sql:
SELECT server_name, database_name, size_gb,
       DENSE_RANK() OVER (
       ) AS size_rank
FROM databases
hints: PARTITION BY separates rankings for different servers.
DENSE_RANK is required because tied sizes must not leave gaps.
solution_explanation: DENSE_RANK builds an independent size ranking for each server.
